```plato

    // True when the curve is (near) planar at t: torsion within the given
    // non-negative tolerance of zero.
    IsPlanarAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve3D, t: Number, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.TorsionAt(t).Abs <= tolerance;
```
